question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Departing or having departed from a country to settle elsewhere
solution:
The correct answer is: **Emigrant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Departing"** or "having departed from a country to settle elsewhere" refers to someone who leaves their native country to live in another. (किसी देश को छोड़कर अन्यत्र बसने के लिए प्रस्थान करना)

 
 
• **Example: **He became an emigrant when he decided to leave India and settle in Canada.
 
 
 
• **"Emigrant"** (प्रवासी) is a one-word substitute for someone who leaves their native country to settle in another.
 
 
• **Example: **After years of planning, the emigrant finally left his homeland to start a new life abroad.
 
 
 
• Hence, the term "Emigrant" accurately describes the given statement.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Emigrant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Excommunicate **(बहिष्कृत): To officially exclude someone from participation in the sacraments and services of the Christian Church.

 
 
• **Example: **The church decided to excommunicate the member due to his controversial beliefs.
 
 
 
• **Immigrant **(आप्रवासी): A person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country.
 
 
• **Example: **The immigrant faced many challenges while adapting to the new culture in the United States.
 
 
 
• **Native** (स्थानीय): A person born in a specified place or associated with a place by birth.
 
 
• **Example: **He is a native of Rajasthan and speaks the local dialect fluently.
